card.name: Company statements speaking as "we"
card.fires_on: The word "we" (or the company name) at the start of a quoted corporate statement, and nearby words in the same statement. Also fires weakly on the ends of brand drug names.

modes.label: Corporate quote
modes.description: First-person "We" or a company name opening or continuing a quoted company statement about its actions or position.

modes.label: Brand drug name ending
modes.description: The last piece of a brand drug name in a label sentence about treatment or coadministration.
modes.example: The coadministration of IMBRUV<<ICA>> with strong CYP3A inducers
